dedupe_keys.name: les zones de stationnement payant a roubaix

description: Les zones de stationnement payant à Roubaix is a dataset listed in Roubaix Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Ville de Roubaix. Coverage: Roubaix. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are transports, parking, stationnement. The portal shows 99 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2024-04-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-roubaix-fr-portal.
